messages:
carla: Quick PR to refresh SDK examples for streaming + pagination: adding cancellation and explicit backoff options. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891

tom: Nice. Can we demonstrate both AbortSignal cancellation (TS) and context cancellation (Go)? Those are common asks.

anya: I can author the TS snippet. Suggest showing a short AbortController example and also how to resume with a `cursor` value.

carla: Good call. For Python show the `retry` config shape we recommend in Optimize. Keep each example under 10 lines.

kevin: Small reminder: our public docs should avoid exposing internal config keys. Use `retry: {strategy: 'exp', maxAttempts: 3}` rather than `exp_backoff_ms` internals.

docs-bot: lint: found bare HTTP link in the Go example comment. Use markdown link or remove the comment.

carla: Draft snippets below. Feedback welcome.

carla: ```ts
const ac = new AbortController();
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 2000); // cancel after 2s
for await (const p of client.stream('gpt-medium', { prompt: 'short story', maxTokens: 150, cursor: null, signal: ac.signal, retry: { strategy: 'exp', maxAttempts: 2 } })) {
  console.log(p.text)
}
```

carla: ```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.stream('gpt-medium', 'summary', max_tokens=80, cursor=None, retry={'strategy': 'exp', 'max_attempts': 2}):
    print(chunk.text)
```

carla: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
defer cancel()
iter := client.Stream(ctx, "gpt-medium", redwood.StreamOpts{Prompt: "bullet points", MaxTokens: 60, Cursor: ""})
for iter.Next() { fmt.Println(iter.Current().Text) }
```

kevin: Looks solid. Two nitpicks: 1) use `cursor: null` in TS to be explicit; 2) add a one-line note under each snippet about resuming from a saved cursor token.

anya: I'll add the resume note text and a tiny smoke test that runs the Python snippet in docs CI. Can someone add the Go/TS smoke job?

tom: I'll wire up the GH actions job `examples-runtime-check` to run the Go and TS snippets using the local examples harness. Will also add a small env var guard so CI skips when creds absent. ETA a few hours.

carla: docs-bot flagged the link; removed the inline comment. Pushed updated PR.

docs-bot: link-checker: ok. import-checker: changed Go import to `github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go` — verified.

kevin: Great. Once CI smoke tests pass I'll approve. Thanks everyone.

carla: Thanks — will merge after green. If we get questions from users about tokens vs cursor naming I'll file a short FAQ entry.
